description:
Listed building consent .
Following a vehicular impact, the plinth supporting railings guarding the light well of the property have been damaged. This has also damaged render/masonry on the internal wall of the light well. We propose to removed the damaged plinth and reset the railings into a new concrete plinth. The new concrete plinth will match the dimensions of the damaged stone plinth. We note that the railing further along Townsend Yard have been repaired in a similar fashion following damage also caused through vehicular impact, at some time in the past. As part of these works the existing railings will be reused, render and masonry forming the inner wall of the light well will also be repaired, where necessary. Followed by a scheme of redecorations to both the railings and light well.
site_name: 42 Highgate High Street, Hornsey, London, N6 5JG
